The '''Crovna system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It containted the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Crovna]].<ref name="TEA" />
